title: Digitization and digital transformation
context: Evaluate the following statements on the concept of digitization and digital transformation:
statements: Digitization is the use of digital information and communication technology.
Digital transformation means the change that this application is driving in parts of the economy, administration and the private sector.
Digitization and digital transformation are interchangeable synonyms without difference of meaning.
The use of technology changes, among other things, how companies control processes, stay in contact with customers and bring products and services to the market.
Digital transformation is already considered complete as soon as hardware is purchased - regardless of whether processes or offers change.
tactical_explanations:
Application is at the centre, not just the purchase of devices. Digitization means the use of digital information and communication technology in concrete processes: systems control, data flow, work steps are supported. Anyone who shortens the term on the possession of a computer or a cash register leaves away exactly this application. The definition binds the expression to doing with technology, not to the inventory list.

The statement is true.

Change follows the application and bears the second name. Digital transformation is the change that the use of digital information and communication technology in parts of the economy, administration and the private sector is driving forward. Process control, customer contact and offer can shift. The term does not describe the same equipment purchase again, but the observable modification that the application triggers.

The statement is true.

Two coupled terms, not a pair of synonyms. Digitization calls the application of digital information and communication technology; digital transformation calls the change that has been initiated. Those who exchange both words without difference of meaning mix tools and effects. They are linked, but remain distinct: first the commitment, then the change in economy, administration or private life. The chain of scene over concept to effect breaks with "digitalization and digital transformation are interchangeable synonyms..." and makes the statement wrong.

The statement is false.

Business activities change in several places at the same time. Technology affects how companies control internal processes, how they stay in contact with customers and how they design products and services and bring them to the market. Later, the representation assigns the same effects to the three dimensions: backstage, frontstage and digitized result. The sentence captures this very broad influence.

The statement is true.

Hardware alone does not complete the transformation. Digital transformation means the change that is driven by the application of digital technology. Simply acquisition without changing processes or offers does not meet this standard. Technology without noticeable conversion would be application without transformation; the sentence explains the purchase to the finished final state and grasps too short.

The statement is false.
